findings.body: The link color becomes noticeably lighter (primary lightened 70% instead of the original 30%), a visible regression versus the prior appearance; every other conversion in this patch preserves the original light-theme lightness.
findings.failure_mode: Existing light-theme styling silently changes color contrary to the stated intent of only adding dark-theme support.
findings.impact: The link color becomes noticeably lighter (primary lightened 70% instead of the original 30%), a visible regression versus the prior appearance; every other conversion in this patch preserves the original light-theme lightness.
findings.root_cause: The refactor swapped the intended light-theme lightness (30%) into the dark-theme complement position, changing both values instead of preserving the original 30%.
findings.suggested_fix: Use dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%)) to keep the light-theme value at 30% and make the dark-theme value the 70% complement.
findings.title: Light-theme color changed from 30% to 70% in reply-to h5 anchor
findings.trigger: Rendering the topic reply expansion (.topic-meta-data h5 a) under the default light theme.
findings.verifier_reason: Patch confirms L291 changed from `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)` to `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%))`. The light-theme value changed from 30% to 70%, which is a visible regression. The claim is accurate and grounded.

findings.body: The text becomes much darker (primary lightened 30% instead of the original 70%), a visible regression; the desktop counterpart correctly preserved 70% (primary 70%, secondary 30%).
findings.failure_mode: Existing light-theme styling silently changes color, and it diverges from the desktop rule for the same component.
findings.impact: The text becomes much darker (primary lightened 30% instead of the original 70%), a visible regression; the desktop counterpart correctly preserved 70% (primary 70%, secondary 30%).
findings.root_cause: The light-theme lightness (70%) and dark complement (30%) were transposed during conversion, altering the original light-theme value.
findings.suggested_fix: Use dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%)) to match the original 70% light-theme value.
